blocks.content:
The build is signed and notarized, so it installs without Gatekeeper warnings. With the tiny caps (tail 30 / history 30 / page 10), any conversation over ~30 messages exercises the feature:

1. Open a long conversation → scroll to the top → older 10-row pages should load with a spinner and no viewport jump.
2. Keep walking up past ~60 rows → history prunes and the **gap affordance** appears between history and tail.
3. Scroll back down toward the gap (or click it) → refill pages close the hole.
4. While scrolled back, let an agent stream → viewport must not move; scroll-to-bottom jumps to the live tail instantly.
